rows.Kwic: 亦不可謂空境空心，忘我忘物，當為究竟。縱空得心，若淋過死灰一般；忘得形，似朽株槁木無二，有甚用處？

Override.AttributionNote: Recorded Sayings of Yuanjie Ying (元潔瑩禪師語錄): in his general address, Yuanjie Ying rejects treating an emptied mind like drenched dead ashes as ultimate.
